headline: Fortinet lifts annual revenue forecast on strong cybersecurity demand
summary: Cybersecurity firm Fortinet on Wednesday lifted its annual revenue forecast after ‌reporting strong second-quarter results, signaling strong enterprise ‌spending on its services amid rising data security incidents. Companies are ​ramping up data security budgets to tackle increasingly sophisticated ransomware attacks and other threats. The California-based company now projects annual revenue between $8.02 billion and $8.18 billion, ‌compared with its ⁠previous expectation of $7.71 billion to $7.87 billion.
